newsitem.title: DENMARK: German missing after Greenland helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: German missing after Greenland helicopter crash.

text.p: A German film camera man is missing after a helicopter crash on the west coast of Greenland some 500 km (300 miles) north of the Arctic Circle, the Danish news agency Ritzau reported.
Martin Heinrich Gehbauer was filming in the Danish Arctic territory on Friday. As the helicopter flew low over a fjord near the town of Ilulissat, its engine died and it plunged into the water.
Pilot Svend Olsen escaped from the sinking helicopter and was rescued by a boat involved in the filming. But the film crew's diver was unable to find Gehbauer, 29, Ritzau said.
The helicopter was operated by a local charter firm, Air Alpha
